title: The Pit Gladiators
text: Damned souls fight in an arena of bone for the devils' amusement, hacking at each other with rusted blades, healing, fighting again. The winner goes free, they say. No one in the stands can remember a winner.

options.label: The strongest steps into the arena, to win what no one here has won.

outcomes.text: Victory, and the roar of the stands, and the devils taking note.
Defeat, and the long walk out on someone else's legs.

options.label: Free a gladiator, and deny the devils their sport.

outcomes.text: The devils are displeased, and they come down from the stands.

options.label: The shrewdest bets on the fights, and plays the devils at their own game.

outcomes.text: Winnings in devil coin, hot to the touch.
Lost, every coin. The devils laugh as they count it.
